title: tracker audit --json
description: What audit found in the whole store (DESIGN.md §3): signs that a file was edited by hand. It exits 0 whatever it finds.

items.description: How many item files were read as items and checked.

problems.description: Each problem found, items first by ID, then deleted.json's lines in order. Empty when nothing was found.

problem.description: status: the state doesn't match the last move in history. verification: a done item with no verification record. ref: a done auto or human item whose refs/tracker/<ID> is missing or doesn't point at its record's commit. held: holds or held questions that only an item in review can have, or that don't agree. id: an ID used twice, by an item and a deleted.json line or by two lines. deleted: a deleted.json line that can't be read, or whose ID is at or above its project's counter.

id.description: The item or deleted.json line it's about. Left out for a line that can't be read.
